html: † [תְּרֵין] n.m., תַּרְתֵּין (K§ 65, Anm. 1) f., two (so in Aramaic dialects generally (note Nab. f. תרתין over ag. Palm. תרתן Lzb 385); v. PhilippiZMG xxxii (1878), 21 ff.; adj. according to M-A§ 89 b);—m. only cstr. in תִּרֵי עֲשַׂר twelve, after n.m. pl. Dn 4:26; Ezr 6:17; f. after n.f. pl. שְׁנִין שִׁתִּין וְת׳ Dn 6:1 years sixty and two; = ord., שְׁנַת תַּרְתֵּין Ezr 4:24 second year.
